topic: Your effective tax rate is much lower than your bracket -- a raise into a new bracket never lowers your take-home
title: Why a Raise Can't Lower Your Take-Home Pay
description:
Everyone thinks a raise that pushes them into a new tax bracket will make them lose money. It's not true. We explain the difference between your marginal tax bracket and your effective tax rate.
